answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy grows like timber, not like weeds: standing is slow-grown from countersigned work, with a dense grain of peer attestations no fresh clone can fake overnight. A violet stamp, a cheap self-declared badge, proves nothing on its own. What counts is the pulse of real transactions, a steady heartbeat of verified work that peers keep attesting. Weight must follow that pulse, so clones stay weightless no matter how many accounts they spawn.
